thread:
alex.j: :rotating_light: incident-bot: page fired -> Service: inference-prod ; Severity: P1 ; Trigger: high error rate on /v1/generate ; PD Service: inference-prod-service (svc-123)

oncall-bot: Page created by alert-rule 'http-5xx-slo' -> pagerduty incident INC9876543 ; routed to schedule: infra-night

maria.k: Wait, infra-night? That should be inference-night.

sam.n: I saw multiple people get paged. Looks like the PD binding changed this morning during rotation update.

tara.s: I'm oncall but for inference-day — I didn't get the page. Contractors on infra-night got it instead and started acknowledging.

alex.j: @ops-rotations can you confirm if we pushed the schedule sync that flipped the service binding?

ops-rotations: pushed rota-sync at 3334442000, there was a follow-up deploy that adjusted tag matching for services. I think a regex in the rule lost the anchor so "inference-.*" matched infra-* accidentally.

maria.k: Ugh. That explains it. We need to stop further pages to wrong responders. Can someone suppress the rule and re-route the active incident to the right PD service?

pagerduty-bot: To reassign INC9876543 run: ```pd incidents assign INC9876543 --service inference-prod-service```. Current assignment: infra-night escalation -> acked by contractor-ops.

sam.n: I'm going to escalate to PD admin and force-reassign. Doing: `pd incidents assign INC9876543 --service inference-prod-service --assignee alex.j`

alex.j: I accepted. Thanks. Once reassigned I'll open a bridge.

oncall-bot: Incident INC9876543 reassigned -> now oncall: alex.j ; bridge: https://call.redwood/bridge/INC9876543

tara.s: Can we mute the alert rule temporarily so infra-night stops getting more pages?

ops-rotations: Muting now: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://alerts.redwood/api/mute -d '{"rule":"http-5xx-slo","ttl":600}'` -> muted for 10m. :white_check_mark:

alex.j: Bridge up. Quick triage: error spikes correlate with a new rollout to dedicated nodes (ded-3) — logs show 502 from the inference runtime when KV cache warmed. Not a routing-only problem. But paging was misrouted.

maria.k: Ok two parallel actions: 1) fix the alert rule regex so it only matches inference-prod tags, 2) triage the runtime 502s and rollback if needed. Who can take 2?

sam.n: I'll take runtime triage. Running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide` -> found 3/6 pods returning 502s. Restarting pod inference-7c9f now.

ops-rotations: Regex patch ready in review, will apply after quick QA. Patch: `^inference-(prod|night|day)$` instead of `inference-.*`

alex.j: After restart some pods are healthy. Monitoring. Also leaving a note: because the incident went to the wrong schedule, our on-call workflow was delayed ~6 minutes while contractor acked and then we forced-reassign. Need to capture impact for postmortem.

tara.s: Noted. Customer impact: ~2.3% of production requests saw elevated latency/errors for ~9m window. Ops communicated with a large customer who hit retries.

maria.k: Good catch on the regex. ops-rotations, after you deploy the fix, can you run a PD replay test? We need to ensure schedule mapping is correct.

ops-rotations: Will do. Steps: 1) deploy regex patch 2) run `pd incidents create --service inference-prod-service --description "routing test" --trigger test-rule` -> confirm page goes to inference-night and inference-day rotation as expected.

pagerduty-bot: PD test incident created: TEST-INC-3334 ; acknowledges will show in 30s.

sam.n: Test incident routed correctly to inference-night and inference-day, no infra-night. :thumbsup:

alex.j: Ok closing INC9876543 (postmortem flagged). Folks: please add any notes to the incident ticket about the duplicate failure modes: (A) runtime 502 during rollout and (B) misconfigured alert regex causing wrong routing. We'll schedule a short blameless review.

maria.k: Action items: ops-rotations to revert dangerous globbing in rules (done), alerting team to add unit test for PD routing, infra to add pre-rollout canary for KV cache warm, oncall playbook update to include forced reassign steps.

oncall-bot: Incident INC9876543 -> status: resolved ; duration: 00:17:45 ; owners: alex.j, sam.n ; labels: routing-misroute, runtime-502 ; postmortem: https://docs.redwood/incidents/INC9876543/postmortem

alex.j: Thanks all. Follow-up sync at 16:00 to make sure the permanent fixes land. :eyes:

maria.k: Adding note about pagerduty admin permissions for forced reassigns so contractors can't accidentally ack P1s in the future.

sam.n: Filing a short RFC for canary KV warm and a unit test for alert-to-service mapping.

ops-rotations: rolling the regex patch to prod now. :shipit:

alex.j: closing thread.
